def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    cells=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==5]
    r0=min(r for r,c in cells); r1=max(r for r,c in cells)
    c0=min(c for r,c in cells); c1=max(c for r,c in cells)
    ir0,ir1=r0+1,r1-1; ic0,ic1=c0+1,c1-1
    rm=(ir0+ir1+1)//2; cm=(ic0+ic1+1)//2
    ranges={('top','left'):(range(ir0,rm),range(ic0,cm)),
            ('top','right'):(range(ir0,rm),range(cm,ic1+1)),
            ('bottom','left'):(range(rm,ir1+1),range(ic0,cm)),
            ('bottom','right'):(range(rm,ir1+1),range(cm,ic1+1))}
    opposite={('top','left'):('bottom','right'),('top','right'):('bottom','left'),('bottom','left'):('top','right'),('bottom','right'):('top','left')}
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        for c,v in enumerate(row):
            if v==0 or v==5: continue
            vert='top' if r<r0 else 'bottom' if r>r1 else None
            horiz='left' if c<c0 else 'right' if c>c1 else None
            if vert is None or horiz is None: continue
            for quad in ((vert,horiz),opposite[(vert,horiz)]):
                rows,cols=ranges[quad]
                for rr in rows:
                    for cc in cols: out[rr][cc]=v
    return out
